text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Firrrst plaaace!! Aww yeaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
The party girl beat the refined lady!? 
This is straight-up revolutionary!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Btw, Helios is crazy strong!! Even though 
she's always goofing off like that...!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on a sec?! That was sooo for 
reaaal fun, though?!?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, hype me up more! Clap 
your haaaands!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Your vibes are losing steam at that rate!! 
Give me more!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yaaay♪

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Daiichi Ruby... You may not have 
achieved a three-generation sweep, but 
that was a magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Um, so in the case of sprint distances, 
what sort of race will you be moving on to 
next?

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I think... I might take a break from 
cheering. I'm not prepared to watch 
Ruby-sama's decline any longer...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Pathetic. Utterly—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Milady! Milaaadyyy~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun! Totally wicked--!! 
Having my fave as my rival is the 
ultimate, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, I was totally cool, wasn't I? Not 
to toot my own horn, but☆ Ehehe☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, you can still run, right? Huh? 
Hey hey?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I must retrain myself from the ground 
up. So that I will never lose to "anyone" 
ever again.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Ms. Helios. If you will 
excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "...To nobody? Yourself??"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Doesn't something feel totally off!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ah totally won! Did ya not even see 
that, Miss!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From what I've heard, Daiichi Ruby is 
pushing herself immensely. A half-hearted 
victory might not even register to her..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Boring!! I can't get hyped if Milady isn't 
watching!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And nobody even laughed at all!! 
Boo-oo-or-ing~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uhya!?
choice_data_list: That's Totally Lacking Hype, Isn't It!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? You're really trying to rile me 
up, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm a hardcore party animal, 
alright?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Morning hype? Nah, at this point it's way 
past morning, it's dinner time!!
choice_data_list:
Then let's level up our party game even 
more!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, young lady, will ya totally 
stan me!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By the time I clash with Daiichi Ruby 
again, I'll become an overwhelming 
presence. To hone my party-people vibe, 
I'll aim for the prelude to the Yasuda 
Kinen, which she'll surely target too――"
choice_data_list: Let's bring the hype at the Milers Cup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Yomiuri Milers Cup.
